<p align="center">
  Every new session, your agent starts from zero. It re-reads the same files, re-asks the same questions, and walks back into mistakes you already fixed together.
</p>

<p align="center">
  Claude-Mem runs a second agent beside it that takes notes while it works. The next session starts with a short index of what matters, and pulls in the details only when it needs them. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and 11 more agents. Copilot CLI, Goose, Roo Code and Warp can search your memory, but their sessions aren't recorded.
</p>

---

## Quick Start

**Installing for someone as an AI agent?** If the user is available, run `npx claude-mem install --setup browser` on their computer and keep it running. It prepares the local runtime, then opens setup in their browser; if the page doesn't open, give them the printed URL. Every choice (agents, integrations, skills, model, usage analytics, the optional email) is made by the user on that page, so there are no terminal questions to relay. If the user is away, run `npx claude-mem install --setup defer`: it prepares the
